metadata.description: IXO's plugins for AI assistants: signed decisions on claims, your IXO memory, and asks.world.

plugins.name: asks
plugins.description: Expert Reviews on asks.world: get your app or agent reviewed by specialists, or review and earn, with your own key held on your machine. Real-world asks and hiring stay available. Say "dry run" to practise on testnet with play money.

plugins.name: asks-dev
plugins.description: asks.world for the IXO team only: the same plugin on the newest @dev server, which may change or break at any time. Everyone else installs asks.

plugins.name: ixo-memory
plugins.description: Your IXO Companion's memory — remember, recall and import what matters, with your IXO sign-in.

plugins.name: ixo-memory-devnet
plugins.description: Your IXO Companion's memory — remember, recall and import what matters, with your IXO sign-in. Devnet (test network).

plugins.name: ixo-memory-testnet
plugins.description: Your IXO Companion's memory — remember, recall and import what matters, with your IXO sign-in. Testnet (test network).

plugins.name: ixo-oracle-builder
plugins.description: IXO Oracle Builder: build your own IXO evaluation oracle with your AI agent, no coding background needed. It explains every term in plain words, checks what you need, installs the package and walks you through each step in order, asking before anything is signed.

plugins.name: ixo-swiftdrop-devnet
plugins.description: Proof of delivery for SwiftDrop Express couriers, decided by IXO's independent engine — devnet (test network).
